teaser: The hum of a laptop fan, left running after the call ended, fills the room. You are a life path 8, built for building something that lasts and counted in dollars or authority, and an INFP, built for feeling your way to what is true before you can explain why. Most 8s want the world to register what they've built. Most INFPs want it to matter, quietly, on their own terms. In you, those two don't argue so much as take turns running the week—one morning counting what's owed, one evening unreachable, writing something no one asked for.
excerpt: The trailhead lot where the gate lock sticks every single time—someone has to jiggle it just right, and you're usually the one who remembers how.
